This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
RUN_ANTENNA_REPAIR - the step crashes FastRoute with GRT-0183 on the clock delay nets,
depending on placement, and has never found anything to repair. The detailed router still
repairs antennas and CI fails on any antenna violation.
DRT_ANTENNA_REPAIR_ITERS - the detailed router's repair loop stops once clean; 3 left one
net on the power-up build (64 -> 7 -> 1 -> 1), and 6 left one on the 8x4 fill build.
GRT_ADJUSTMENT - Metal3 is the only horizontal signal layer; at the default 0.3 global
routing overflows on 8x4. At 0.15 detailed routing closes but runs past CI's 6 h; at 0.06
the whole harden took 3 h 37 min with the slow corner +0.43 ns.
DESIGN_REPAIR_MAX_WIRE_LENGTH - the engines sit 1.5 mm apart, by their macros. Unset, a
routed push crossed on one 2.3 mm net from an o21ai_1 and missed the slow corner by 0.07 ns.
RUN_POST_GRT_* - on 8x4, hold repair after CTS put 1.4 ns of delay cells on the routed
push and nothing checked setup again, so it missed the slow corner by 1.24 ns with 104
slew violations. Repairing again on the global routes closes both.
OPENROAD_THREADS - unset, LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3 passes '-threads None' and OpenROAD runs
on one thread. 4 is a GitHub runner's core count; local hardens override it with -c.
SRAM macro integration, see odb_sram_stripes.py
Die art, see die_art.py: the carrier board's cat fills this Metal4 box, which sits
between two PDN stripe pairs so they miss its face.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
